scoring_justification: Full DFT recomputation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; instead compare the agent's reported numerical results against the paper's reference values with domain-appropriate tolerances (result-level structural comparison).

outputs.description: Six numerical values from DFT calculations: lattice parameter, internal coordinate, static dielectric constant, plasma frequency, maximum NIR absorption coefficient, and reflectivity dip energy.

output_contract.notes: All six fields must be present. The checker compares each field to the paper-reported gold within domain-appropriate tolerances; fields carry equal weight.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for six structural/optical quantities of KB6
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: a0=4.207460 Å, z=0.198864; text: static dielectric constant ε1(0)=19.70; energy-loss function peak at 1.41 eV (plasma frequency); absorption maximum 128686 cm⁻¹ at 1.15 eV; reflectivity dip at 1.73 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported results.
